notes: Top post: "I texted a client after hours" (110 impressions/7 engagements, Wed 8/12). Started per-post/day-of-week tracking in post-performance.csv and daily-engagement.csv this week — see those for the cadence analysis.

Top post: "Most advisors specialize in one lane" (78 impressions/1 engagement, Mon 8/17). Discovered this week that LinkedIn's Top Posts export reports activity within the report window, not lifetime totals per post — post-performance.csv now logs each export as a dated snapshot (export_period_start/end columns) instead of overwriting a post's row, so history isn't lost when a post's in-window numbers are lower than a prior week's. Also corrected 8/17 in daily-engagement.csv (81 impr/4 eng vs. 64/3 previously) — LinkedIn revises recent days as more data lands.

Top post: "I've noticed people creating their contracts" (90 impressions/4 engagements, Wed 8/26). Cadence read updated: Wednesday still leads (avg 35.6 impressions across 5 posts) vs. Monday (10.3 avg, 7 posts) and Friday (12.2 avg, 9 posts) — pattern holding as sample size grows, though still below the 5-6-posts-per-day threshold for calling it confirmed on all three days. profile_views_90d and search_appearances_7d filled in from the separate analytics page Jackie pastes in; that page reported 286 post impressions vs. 285 from the Aggregate Analytics export's DISCOVERY sheet — kept the export figure since it's the more precise/auditable source, logging the 1-off discrepancy here rather than silently picking one.

Top post: "Recently I had a prospective client ask" (104 impressions/11 engagements, Wed 9/2). Cadence read: Wednesday still leads (avg 40.2 impressions across 6 posts) vs. Monday (19.4 avg, 7 posts, pulled up by one outlier at 112 impressions) and Friday (11.4 avg, 8 posts) — all three weekdays now have 6+ posts, crossing the sample-size threshold for treating this as a real pattern rather than noise.
